Single-select toggle group (the Gavel `Segmented` "Mine / All / Bots" pattern). A muted track holds mutually-exclusive segments; the active segment lifts onto the card surface. Built on clicky tokens so it inherits dark-mode and density. Use for small, flat choice sets — reach for `Select` when the option count grows.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/SegmentedControl.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { SegmentedControl } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
